packet.title: EXI in the processor: functions, the output method, schemaId
packet.summary: The feature sxml_exi_feature, exi:serialize and exi:parse, the output method exi:exi with its parameters, sxml_processor_parse_exi_document, the schemaId resolver, and the options reader.

item.p: Mechanism: src/function_library_exi.c (as src/function_library_binary.c, ), the method in src/serialize.c, its parameters in the serialization parameter reader, fn:serialize refusing the method with SEPM0016, the options reader of an exi:header element, the processor's cache of compiled schemas per schemaId.
Done when: XQuery and XSLT tests (tests/exi_function_test.c) serialize and parse through every path; the gate script passes.
